contexts.text: Mine iniquity is greater than can be taken away () = despair.
The Angels cannot take away the pain (of the punishments).
There is a separation (of evils there); never a plenary taking away of them. AC 2449:end.
If evil were suddenly taken away from man, it would extinguish the fire of his first life.
Suffer themselves to be carried away by the world.
These truths are taken away from him there.
For externals are there taken away.
That truths and goods are to be taken away from those who are in falsities, and transferred to those of the Spiritual Church. Treated of. AC 6920. AC 7770:2. Signified.
The first degree of the taking away of the influx of truth and good. Signified, Explained.
For they know how to take away the influx of Heaven...
When the knowledge of faith is taken away from them, as happens with such in the other life, they are gross of mind.
The Lord does not take away evil, but withholds man from it. References.
Therefore such (pretended goods) are taken away from them...
Under Steal, see this reference.
The taking away of exterior and interior good. Treated of... The taking away is effected by evil; and the alienation by falsity.
For the external is taken away (from the evil Spirits)... It is taken away by the letting in of the light from Heaven...
As soon as infants are raised up... they are carried away into Heaven.
(What is meant by) being carried away by the spirit into another place. HH 441, Explained.

After death, those things which do not make a one with the reigning love are removed and as it were taken away. Explained... Truths are taken away from the evil; and falsities are taken away from the good.
With such, all the truths they had known from the Word and from the doctrine of the Church are taken away.
When, in the other life, externals are taken away from them, and internals are revealed...
That the prophet by bearing the iniquities of the house of Israel... did not take them away...
(Thus) the Lord did not take away sins by the passion of the cross; but He takes them away, that is, removes them, with those who believe in Him by living according to His precepts. Illustrated.
These two faculties are never taken away from man. DLW 247, Explained. DLW 264.
If the life of the love of evil has been his, all the truth which he had acquired in the world... is taken away...; and, conversely...
With those who are interiorly evil and exteriorly good, good is taken away... and conversely with those who are interiorly good...
From these (hypocrites and Pharisees) everything true and good is taken away after death...
The life's love... remains with everyone after death, and cannot be taken away.
That the things of worship will be taken away, and they shall not know when and how. Signified, Explained.
That the talent and the pound for trading will be taken away from a man if he gains nothing. Explained. AR 676:end.
As the taking away of good and truth from those in dead worship is done as if by a thief in the dark. Illustrated.

The Divine Providence that they cannot take away any truth and good of faith, nor the affection and perception of them, from any but those who are not in charity and consequently not in faith. Signified, Explained.
Take away affection, and can you think any thing...
An influx from the Lord... to take away truths and goods from them... Signified, Explained.
He carried me away in the spirit upon a great and high mountain () = John translated into the Third Heaven.

That goods will be taken away from those who are in evils, and that truths will be taken away from those who are in falsities; and, on the other hand, that evils will be taken away from those who are in goods, and that falsities will be taken away from those who are in truths. Signified, Explained.

If anyone shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God shall take away his part out of the book of life, and out of the holy city, and the things which are written in this book () = that those who read and know the truths of doctrine of this book now opened by the Lord, and yet acknowledge any other God than the Lord, or any other faith than faith in Him, by taking away anything by which they may destroy these two, cannot be wise in and appropriate to themselves anything from the Word, nor be received into the New Jerusalem, nor have their lot with those who are in the Lord's kingdom. Explained.
Therefore if will were taken away, action would come to a stand in a moment; and if thought were taken away, speech would (do so).
After death, when their external... has been taken away...
This (free will) He never takes away from anyone.
That Spirits take away delights. Explained.
Then (after some years) goods are taken away from them.
From him shall be taken away even that which he hath (). Explained.
That goods and truths are taken away from the evil, is known from the Word. Illustrated.
Before they come (into Hell) there is taken away from them all they had previously learned from the Word, and all they had known of faith, and also the Knowledge of who they had been (here).
